item.title: Plateau Fulani Christians deny links to Miyetti Allah, MACBAN
item.description: The Fulani Christian Association of Nigeria, FCAN, has denied having any links with the Miyetti Allah Kautal Hore Allah and Miyetti Allah Cattle Breeders Association of Nigeria, MACBAN, following recent classification of the two groups as terrorist organizations by the United States Congress.
